read.thesis: Synchrony's Q4 2025 read: record $49B purchase volume and NCO down 108bp to 5.37%, but 2026 EPS guide of $9.10–$9.50 is roughly flat with mid-single-digit receivables growth and rising reserve and expense investment.

capex.quote: we have increased our capital spend a bit.

triggers.label: Purchase volume up 3% to record
triggers.quote: purchase volume turned the corner, nice trajectory, up 3% versus last year.

triggers.label: NIM up 82bp to 15.83%
triggers.quote: Our fourth-quarter net interest margin increased 82 basis points versus last year to 15.83%

triggers.label: 2026 EPS $9.10–$9.50 vs $9.28 FY25
triggers.quote: net earnings per diluted share between $9.10 and $9.50 for the full year 2026

triggers.label: Capex raised for AI, cloud, health
triggers.quote: we have increased our capital spend a bit.

guidance.quote: net earnings per diluted share between $9.10 and $9.50 for the full year 2026
we expect average active account and purchase volume growth to drive mid-single-digit ending receivables growth
We currently also expect our portfolio net charge-off rate to be in line with our long-term target of 5.5% to 6%.
RSAs are expected to increase, reflecting stronger program performance, but remain within our target of 4% to 4.5% of average receivables.

red_flags.label: Receivables down 1% YoY; growth guide depends on Walmart/Lowe's
red_flags.quote: ending loan receivables decreased 1% to $104 billion in the fourth quarter

red_flags.label: Reserve build and expense investment compress 2026 EPS
Management says probability of default across grades is higher than historical norms
red_flags.quote: probability of default across credit grades is higher than historical norms.

evasions.topic: Reserve rate trajectory and 2026 EPS composition
evasions.quote: We haven't given guidance or what you actually should think about relative to or anything, to be honest with you

evasions.topic: Pay Later contribution to loan growth
evasions.quote: We can't get specific on any of our individual programs.
